This small plot of 0.22 hectares is where I grow my other crop, and I keep it close to the house so I can watch it every day. I do not buy fertilizer from the cooperative for this plot — one bag is too much for such a small piece of land, and the cash I have this season must go to the bigger plots where we grow our grain. Instead I carry manure from the cattle pen and spread it before planting, the way my mother did and the way my neighbors still do. I keep my own seed from last harvest because the agro-dealer in town does not sell improved seed for this crop, and I have never seen a neighbor try something different and do better. I weed by hand with my daughter, and since the plot is small we do not need to hire anyone.
